svg.title: Pathview-plus analysis workflow
svg.desc: Flowchart of the Pathview-plus pipeline: user input flows through pathway database download, parallel KGML or SBGN-ML parsing, ID mapping, data aggregation, color mapping, and rendering to PNG, SVG, or PDF outputs with optional post-hoc highlighting and Bezier splines.

g.text: KEGG REST API · Reactome · MetaCyc · PANTHER · SMPDB
